text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet put up a great fight in the 
Japanese Derby, but—

Even after the race, you can't get Vodka's 
spirited run—and the image of her becoming 
number one—out of your head.

Determined not to fall any further behind 
Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet swore to become the 
number one who would never lose to her.

Her next destination is the Shuka Sho, the 
final leg of the Triple Tiara.
